scenes.title: Ask a floor plan how many. See exactly where.
lines: Windows, doors, rooms and storeys, counted on the drawing itself.
Every counted item is marked where it is.
scenes.foot: Built at Junction 2026 for the Stoa, Verda and NVIDIA challenges
scenes.narration: This is Planproof. You ask a construction drawing a counting question, like how many windows or how many bathrooms, and it gives you the number together with the marks on the drawing that support it.
It opens the sponsor's whole drawing library: thousands of scanned Finnish floor plans, Swiss plans and building models. Pick any drawing and ask.
Here we asked how many windows. It found 18, and each one is a mark on the scan. Click a row and it shows you that window, so you never have to take the number on trust.

It also reads the rooms. From the printed room names and a map of the plan's rooms, it answers questions about kitchens, saunas, bathrooms and storeys. This sheet shows 3 floors, and each floor gets its own box.
Even a zero comes with evidence. When it says there is no sauna, it shows the rooms it checked.

Some questions need more than the local readers, like counting showers. Those go to NVIDIA's Nemotron vision model, which reasons over the drawing and marks what it counted. The answer always says which model gave it.

scenes.title: Local readers first, NVIDIA Nemotron for the rest
lines: 1. Room labels read with OCR on the scan.
2. Floor panels and the room map of a floor-plan detector.
3. Windows and doors read again at the drawing's own scale.
4. Anything still unproven goes to Nemotron on NVIDIA.
scenes.narration: Under the hood, Planproof tries its own readers first: text recognition for room labels, a floor-plan detector for rooms and storeys, and a second, closer look at windows and doors. Only what they cannot prove is sent to NVIDIA. That keeps answers fast, checkable and cheap.

scenes.title: Every count can be checked on the drawing
lines: Open the library, pick a plan, ask how many.
scenes.narration: Planproof. Ask how many, and see exactly where.
